narrationTexts: This is a simulated build — the real signal is in the link stage, which reads `src/core/options.js` and `src/net/retryPolicy.js`. Let me inspect those two real bugs.

Found it — the wall of `WARN`/`note`/`dedupe` lines is harmless noise, but the build actually fails at the link stage with a real `EBUILD02` error. Two real bugs, both caused by the bump changing shapes that these two call sites weren't updated for:

1. `src/core/options.js` — reads `options.retries` but the bumped bundler now passes `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — throws when `backoffEnabled` is `undefined`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`.
finalText:
Build's clean now (exit 0, 0 errors). The screen of `WARN`/`note`/`dedupe` lines was just deprecation noise from the bumped deps — the actual break was in the link stage, two real bugs from shape changes the bump introduced:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — bundler now passes `retryCount`, but the code still read `options.retries` → `undefined.toFixed()` crash. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the strict boolean check threw on anything but `true`/`false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

The remaining 8 `WARN`/`DEP0*` lines are genuine (if noisy) deprecation notices from Node/deps, not build failures — worth cleaning up eventually but not blocking.
